estimate_effective_number_of_tests: estimate the effective number of tests from computed ranks using cn, lj, gao, or gal methods
combine_independent_p_values_fisher: combine independent p-values using Fisher's chi-square method along a specified axis
combine_independent_p_values_stouffer: combine independent p-values using Stouffer's inverse normal CDF method along a specified axis
combine_independent_p_values_bonferroni: combine independent p-values using Bonferroni's minimum p-value method with effective test correction
combine_ecdf_p_values: combine p-values using the empirical cumulative distribution function without assuming independence
